283258872.description:
Vintage NES Game Lot Boxed Battletoads Tetris Pipe Dream Loose Mario Bros 3
This lot includes vintage Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) video games with both boxed and loose cartridges. Boxed titles: Battletoads by Tradewest, Tetris, Pipe Dream by Bullet-Proof Software, and Super Sprint by Tengen. Loose cartridges include Super Mario Bros. 3, Yoshi, Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse by Konami, The Goonies II, The Karate Kid, Dig Dug II, Donkey Kong Classics, Monopoly, The Little Mermaid by Capcom, and multiple copies of Super Mario Bros./Duck Hunt. Items show typical wear of used NES games, with some boxes having creases and edge wear. Suitable for collectors or retro gaming enthusiasts.
